What are the latest developments in fusion energy research?
Fusion energy research has seen major milestones recently, including several labs achieving net energy gain in controlled experiments. Private companies have raised substantial funding to build demonstration reactors, targeting grid-connected power within the next decade. Tokamak and inertial confinement approaches remain the two dominant technical paths, each with distinct engineering tradeoffs around magnetic field strength, plasma stability, and materials that can withstand sustained neutron bombardment without excessive degradation over a commercial reactor's operating lifetime.
